parsedVerdict.reasoning:
Both files in src/infrastructure/http handle the HTTP transport boundary. RequestParser.ts checks untrusted request input (bodies and query strings) and raises InvalidRequestError. createApp.ts builds the Express app and connects the routes to the controllers and middleware. These are two parts of the same HTTP concern, not separate ones.

Each rule lives in one place. The required-field and string-type checks exist only in RequestParser, and requiredString reuses optionalString instead of repeating the check. createApp does no parsing or validation of its own, so it does not go around RequestParser.

The graph shows the controllers and errorHandler using RequestParser and InvalidRequestError. That is how the module's abstraction is meant to be used. Import direction is out of scope.
